speaker: Ms Diana Pang Li Yen
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) in the past three years, how many reports of cruelty to community animals has the Animal and Veterinary Service received, investigated, and referred for prosecution; (b) whether the Ministry assesses that existing enforcement powers and penalties adequately deter such offences; and (c) whether stronger protections, better reporting mechanisms, or restrictions on animal ownership for repeat offenders are being considered to safeguard animal welfare.

speaker: Ms Diana Pang Li Yen (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
text: For the community animals, because they do not have a specific owner per se, is there a possibility for the Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS) to make it easier for them to report cases?

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: In fact, I was there at Cats' Day Out last month, and I think the Member Diana Pang was also there, where we worked with Cat Welfare Society, the community feeders, to get feedback and to see how we can better support them.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I was also at the Cats' Day Out.
